description: A security vulnerability has been detected in SourceCodester College Notes Gallery Management System 1.0. This impacts an unknown function of the file signup.php of the component Registration Flow. Such manipulation of the argument role leads to improper privilege management. The attack can be launched remotely. The exploit has been disclosed publicly and may be used.
